response:
Read through the new files. Found one real, concrete bug — everything else looks clean.

- **`Persistence/AtomicFileWriter.swift:34-35` — the atomic write will report failure on every successful save.** `replaceItemAt(url, withItemAt: tempURL)` *moves/consumes* the item at `tempURL` as part of the replace (that's the whole point of the API — no separate cleanup needed). The very next line, `try FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)`, then tries to delete a path that no longer exists, throws "no such file," falls into the `catch`, and gets wrapped as `FileStorageError.failedToWrite(...)` — even though the write actually succeeded. Since this is the shared primitive under all three future stores, this means `GameSaveStore`/`StatsLogStore`/`SettingsStore` would see every single save call fail and could spuriously trigger fallback/data-loss UI on a save that worked fine — exactly the "app lies about the player's own data" failure mode this whole pipeline keeps guarding against. Fix is one line: drop the post-`replaceItemAt` `removeItem` call entirely (or at most wrap it in `try?` and don't let it affect control flow).
- `RecoveryBanner`/`ErrorToast` (Claude B) match their interfaces.json signatures exactly and don't collide with anything I built — `gameRecoveryBanner(_:)`/`settingsErrorToast(_:autoDismissAfter:)` are one-line drop-ins I'll actually use once I build `GameView`/`SettingsView`.
- `HapticsService`/`DefaultHapticsService` (Codex B) match the interfaces.json protocol exactly; haptic assignment (rigid-impact for move/blocked, notification-only for win/stuck) matches `DEC-design_handoff-004`. Not wired into `GameEngine` yet, per Codex B's own note — not blocking my lane.
- Confirmed Codex A's `Domain/Models` split is still clean this round — no duplicate declarations reappeared between `DomainTypes.swift` and `Domain/Models/*.swift`.
- No conflicts between Codex A's `DomainModelTests.swift` / Codex B's `AtomicFileWriterTests.swift` and anything primary_ui owns.
- Still nothing for `SolitaireTabHost`/`GameView` to bind to (`GameEngine`/`AppRestoreCoordinator` both absent) — unchanged from last round, not a new risk, just still blocking.
